description: Free: after paying an x402 endpoint, pass the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header it returned (X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE in v1). Returns the transaction, network and payer it names, whether that transaction exists on-chain and succeeded, and which USDC moved from whom to whom, with an explorer link. Read-only. Limited to 10 calls per hour.
name: check_payment_proof
title: Check an x402 payment proof (free)
